title: K2 projection discipline
exact_source_statement: This chapter uses the vocabulary of OC, the Ontological Calculus, only in that limited sense: as a way of describing organized change without pretending that the ordinary sciences of life have been replaced.
formal_proposition: K2 is valid as an OC projection only where it describes organized biological change without replacing biology.
evidence_match: The K2 chapter explicitly states the non-replacement boundary for biological science.
falsifier: Fails if K2 prose replaces molecular biology, physiology, systems biology, ecology, immunology, or evolutionary theory.
dependency_closure: Depends on K2 source chapter and 036 queue discipline.
verification_note: The non-replacement sentence is present in the K2 source and supports only a formal projection ceiling.

title: K2 measurable variable rule
exact_source_statement: These words are broad, but they earn their place only when they can be tied to observable biological variables.
formal_proposition: K2 terms are admissible only when continuum, boundary, operator, and constraint assignments bind to observable biological variables.
evidence_match: The chapter source gives the observable-variable gate as a condition of use.
falsifier: Fails if OC terms are assigned after the fact with no measurable, perturbable, or function-bound biological variable.
dependency_closure: Depends on K2 source and OC projection non-inflation discipline.
verification_note: The source statement is a methodological rule, not an empirical biology result.
next_action: Use this rule to gate all K2 empirical promotion.

title: K2 state-transition benchmark competence
exact_source_statement: At the molecular level, one may ask whether a regulatory network maintains or changes a cell state through feedback, inhibition, amplification, or repair.
formal_proposition: Within the declared BIOLOGY benchmark surface, OC-style state-transition and response-signature assignments are evidence-bound.
evidence_match: BIOLOGY validation PASS with 30 cases, 3 datasets, coverage=1.0; benchmarks=['BIO_BENCH_001', 'BIO_BENCH_002', 'BIO_BENCH_003']; within_threshold_cases=30.
falsifier: If the bounded signature family fails on held-out datasets, the biological packet remains frontier-bound.
dependency_closure: Depends on BIOLOGY replay/matrix/cases and 031-036 evidence ceilings.
next_action: Use only for benchmark-matched biological state-transition and response-signature claims.

title: K2 boundary and operator benchmark mapping
exact_source_statement: A continuum is a trackable range of variation: temperature, concentration, stiffness, immune activation, developmental state, oxygen tension, or population density.
formal_proposition: Within the BIOLOGY benchmark surface, K2 continuum, boundary, and operator language maps to measured state signatures and replayable response transitions.
evidence_match: benchmarks=['BIO_BENCH_001', 'BIO_BENCH_002', 'BIO_BENCH_003']; Bounded examples: BIO_CASE_001_GSE184558_CTRL_DAY3_1:GSE184558 control differentiation Day3 replicate 1, BIO_CASE_002_GSE184558_CTRL_DAY3_2:GSE184558 control differentiation Day3 replicate 2, BIO_CASE_003_GSE184558_CTRL_DAY3_3:GSE184558 control differentiation Day3 replicate 3; BIO_CASE_011_GSE226159_CPC_01:GSE226159 cardiac progenitor sample CPC_01, BIO_CASE_012_GSE226159_CPC_02:GSE226159 cardiac progenitor sample CPC_02, BIO_CASE_013_GSE226159_CPC_03:GSE226159 cardiac progenitor sample CPC_03; BIO_CASE_021_GSE69063_ANAPHYLAXIS_249_T0:GSE69063 anaphylaxis patient 249 at T0, BIO_CASE_022_GSE69063_ANAPHYLAXIS_249_T1:GSE69063 anaphylaxis patient 249 at T1, BIO_CASE_023_GSE69063_SEPSIS_A_T0:GSE69063 sepsis patient A at T0.

next_action: Do not extend this evidence to wound, biofilm, homeostasis, fever, action potential, or evolutionary examples without local data.

title: K2 wound/biofilm/homeostasis comparative packet
exact_source_statement: The strongest evidence for OC will be comparative rather than singular.
formal_proposition: K2 wound, biofilm, and homeostasis claims require a local comparative evidence packet with observables, perturbations, replay cases, and failure contrasts.
evidence_match: Current BIOLOGY evidence covers state-transition and response-signature benchmarks, not wound-healing regimes, biofilm persistence, fever/homeostasis, action potentials, or evolutionary examples.
falsifier: The comparative packet fails if OC assignments do not distinguish success, failure, and new-regime cases better than ordinary variable lists.
dependency_closure: Depends on future K2-specific comparative biology replay package.
verification_note: No 035/036/BIOLOGY source row supplies a chapter-level wound/biofilm/homeostasis dataset.
next_action: Build K2 comparative packet: wound, biofilm, and homeostasis cases with observables, perturbation outcomes, replay cases, and failure contrasts.

title: K2 descriptive-dimension criterion
exact_source_statement: A new descriptive dimension is therefore not a poetic upgrade.
formal_proposition: K2 permits a new descriptive dimension only when measurement, prediction, perturbation, or explanation requires a distinction unavailable in the old description.
evidence_match: The chapter source gives a criterion for dimension addition, not an empirical proof that any named biological case satisfies it.
falsifier: Fails if a new dimension is added by theoretical preference while old variables still distinguish intervention-relevant cases.
dependency_closure: Depends on K2 source and OC-U/OC-M non-inflation discipline.
verification_note: The source statement ties dimension birth to practical biological work and intervention-relevant distinguishability.
next_action: Require local intervention evidence before claiming any specific biological dimension birth.

title: K2 falsifier and non-overclaim discipline
formal_proposition: K2 is article-safe only when proposed boundaries, operators, contradictions, and emergence claims can fail locally.
evidence_match: The chapter explicitly requires negative evidence and rejects after-the-fact assignment to any biological story.
falsifier: Fails if OC terms apply with equal ease to every biological narrative or erase local mechanism.
dependency_closure: Depends on K2 source and 037 article boundary.
verification_note: The exact negative-evidence passage is present and matches the validator's anti-overclaim rule.
